subject: Post-demo implementation briefing: Clarion SDK, auth, routing & prompt governance
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@clarionhealth.com>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@clarionhealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-20T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo implementation briefing: Clarion SDK, auth, routing & prompt governance

Thanks for taking the demo earlier today — great conversation. I wanted to summarize the technical items we agreed to follow up on and propose next steps so your engineering and security teams have a concrete plan. TL;DR: we can get a small POC running in 2–3 weeks (SDK + auth + embeddings), and a focused red-team session for prompt governance within 4 weeks.

Key technical takeaways from the call:
- SDK setup: Clarion will use our Node + Python SDKs for initial PoC. We recommended the streaming client for the conversational flows that require low latency.
- Auth & routing: Customer wants private VPC deployment later, but initial POC will authenticate via API keys + mTLS for the integration environment. Routing policy: low-latency reads to hosted small-llm, fallback to dedicated when throughput spikes.
- Structured output & tool-calling: We demoed tool-calling for claim-status lookup. For Clarion, we suggested schema-validated JSON output (we can provide a JSON Schema + sample).
- Embeddings & reranker: We'll surface semantic search for claim retrieval using 1536-d embeddings, then rerank top-K with a lightweight cross-encoder on your side or our reranker endpoint. Latency target for retrieval+rerank: sub-400ms on dedicated.
- Prompt governance: Versioned system prompts, input sanitization, and a red-team checklist. Priority items: prompt injection mitigations (user-message isolation + allowlist), and baseline QA prompts for health-safety checks.

Deliverables we will send by EOD Wednesday:
1) Proposed architecture diagram (attachment: clarion-proposed-arch.pdf)
2) Short SDK + auth quickstart (attachment: sdk-auth-snippets.txt)
3) Mutual action plan draft with milestones (attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx)

Asks from Clarion:
- Confirm who will own the PoC infra (Clarion cloud team vs. 3rd party).
- Share any existing embedding model constraints (e.g., HIPAA redaction expectations).
- Identify two engineers for an onboarding session next week (1x backend, 1x security).

Next steps (proposed):
- Wed 2/23: send artifacts above + calendar for onboarding (30–45m).
- Fri 3/5: 2-hour red-team tabletop with sample prompts and adversarial cases.

If that looks good I’ll schedule items and loop in Solutions Engineering for the SDK walkthrough.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: +1 (415) 555-0193

Date: 2027-02-21T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo implementation briefing: Clarion SDK, auth, routing & prompt governance

Thanks Evelyn — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side after huddling with infra/security: 

1) Embeddings and PHI: we need a clear approach for redaction before embeddings are generated. Can you confirm whether Redwood supports PII/PHI token filters in the embedding pipeline or whether we must run pre-processing on our side?

2) Reranker latency: you mentioned a sub-400ms target on dedicated. Can you call out typical numbers for hosted vs dedicated for 2–3k QPS test profile? We need that for procurement sizing.

3) Tool calling / structured output: we’d like an example of the JSON Schema you referenced (especially for claim-status and denial-reason). Also: how do you recommend handling partial failures from external tools (e.g., lookup times out)? Fallback pattern?

People to join PoC onboarding: myself (backend) and Priya (security). We prefer Thurs 2/24 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri 2/25 14:00–15:00 PT.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
Senior Backend Engineer, Clarion Health
samir@clarionhealth.com

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@clarionhealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-21T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo implementation briefing: Clarion SDK, auth, routing & prompt governance

Hey Samir — quick answers inline and attaching a short snippet.

1) Embeddings & PHI: Redwood does not persist raw text to our embedding storage when you use the customer-side redaction hook. We offer two options: (a) pre-processing webhook that runs in your environment to strip/replace PHI before sending, or (b) a server-side redaction pipeline that returns a redaction-hash/consent token if you sign a DPA+BAA (we can discuss the compliance flow). For PoC I recommend (a) to move quickly.

2) Reranker latency: Hosted small-llm + our reranker endpoint typically returns top-10 rerank in ~220–350ms at moderate QPS. Dedicated with a pinned GPU pool cuts that to ~120–200ms (depending on sequence lengths). For 2–3k QPS you’ll want Dedicated with autoscaling rules — I’ll include an estimated pool size in the MAP.

3) Structured output failures: fallback pattern we use: try 1) schema-validated tool-call response, 2) if tool times out return a deterministic error envelope ({"status":"tool_timeout","tool":"claims_db","retry_in":"5s"}) and a safe default UI message. We can also set a synchronous fallback to a cached snapshot of last-known state if available.

Attached: sdk-auth-snippets.txt — contains: Node SDK streaming example, mTLS cert install steps, and example pipeline for pre-send redaction hook.

I can walk through the snippet during the onboarding. For PoC infra ownership, supporting mTLS in a shared staging account is straightforward if you provide a short-lived cert signed by your CA.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: sdk-auth-snippets.txt

- Week 0 (2/24): SDK onboarding + auth config (mTLS & API key fallback)
- Week 1–2: Embeddings ingestion CAAS + reranker tuning; privacy pre-processing hook in place
- Week 3: End-to-end demo with claim retrieval + structured output and error envelopes
- Week 4: Red-team tabletop + prompt injection runbook and final PoC signoff

Action items for Clarion before onboarding:
- Provide a short-lived CA-signed cert (for mTLS) or confirm you want API-key-only POC.
- Share a sample claim JSON (redacted) so we can draft the schema for structured output.

Dev will host the SDK walkthrough and Rishi will cover the routing/fallback policies and SLA expectations. I’ll coordinate the red-team agenda.

Cheers,
Evelyn
